Plot convergence diagnostics

Source: R/model_convergence.R
plot.bmb_convergence.Rd

Rank plots (recommended by Vehtari et al., 2021) or trace plots for the parameters in a check_convergence() result. Parameters that failed a check are shown first.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'bmb_convergence'
plot(x, type = c("rank", "trace"), max_pars = 6L, ...)

Arguments

x

A bmb_convergence object.

type

"rank" (rank-histogram overlay) or "trace".

max_pars

Maximum number of parameters to show.

...

Passed to the bayesplot function.

Value

A ggplot object.
